details.availability: Public environments, BrowserGym task package with verifiers, benchmark scripts, trajectory collection and fine-tuning configs; site data, traces and dataset files are on Hugging Face; no release or tag.

benchmark_protocol.evaluation: Each task's free-text answer is normalized (case, unicode, markdown, punctuation, number formatting) and checked by the verifiers listed in its eval_types (string_match, number_match, list_match, combined with AND); tasks still on llm_judge are graded by GPT-5 by default or an open Gemma judge. The same tasks are run against each UI version.
focus: robustness of web agents to UI redesigns across eras
information seeking across Wiki, News and Shop sites
benchmark_protocol.notes: Task counts were computed from the task file's sites and eval.eval_types fields at the reviewed commit; test.raw.v2.json is byte-identical, and test.raw.llm_judge.json is a variant that routes all 231 tasks to the LLM judge. Results depend on the UI version served, so a score should state the version.
observations: BrowserGym observations of the self-hosted sites, as selected by the agent

name: TimeWarp
notes: Code for the TimeWarp paper, which the README's citation lists as to appear in the NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track. env/ holds Flask apps for Wiki and News and an adapted copy of WebShop for Shop (with WebShop's MIT license text), plus a homepage app; each loads one of six numbered UI themes styled after different eras (the Wiki app also registers a seventh 'modern' theme), and new themes can be added as folders. Site data is downloaded from the Hugging Face dataset sparklabutah/timewarp-env-data. src/browsergym/timewarp registers timewarp.1 to timewarp.231 with BrowserGym; its task file has 231 tasks: 70 Wiki-only, 64 Shop-only, 47 News-only and 50 spanning two or three sites. Agents answer in free text, which is normalized and checked by string_match, number_match and list_match verifiers (AND-combined per task); 2 tasks use only the LLM judge (GPT-5 by default, or a locally served Gemma model). scripts/ runs AgentLab studies per site and sweeps models and UI versions; collectTeacherTraj/ provides a modified AgentLab loop and agent that save teacher trajectories, llamafactory/ has full and LoRA fine-tuning configs for training on them, and the README points to GPT-5 traces on Hugging Face. scripts/annotation holds the verifier authoring and audit tooling, results/ has page-measurement and visual-information validation data, and proofs/ has Lean 4 proofs of the appendix theory. The README shows an MIT badge without a link, and the tree has no root license file. Not a fork, not archived; no release. Code was read, not run.
summary: Web-agent benchmark on self-hosted Wiki, News and Shop sites, each with six era-styled UI versions, registering 231 BrowserGym tasks scored mainly by deterministic answer verifiers.
